issues.title: Form 2257 model release flow
issues.description:
[https://form.jotform.com/222776518165160](https://form.jotform.com/222776518165160)

form 2257 model release flow

Link to OF implementation: [https://onlyfans.com/my/release-forms](https://onlyfans.com/my/release-forms)

OnlyFans primarily detects the need for a model release form through

**user tagging**

and a combination of **automated content moderation systems** and **human review**

If unverified individuals appear in content, the system flags it for review and requires the creator to provide documentation.

**OnlyFans Detection Process**

* **Verified Collaborator Tagging:** The primary method is a built-in system where creators tag the verified accounts of other models in their content. This tag automatically confirms the collaborator's age (18+) and consent, negating the need for a separate form.
* **Automated Content Scanning:** OnlyFans employs "state-of-the-art digital technologies" (including AI and computer vision) to pre-screen all uploaded content for restricted material and unverified faces.
* **Human Moderation & Flagging:** Content that passes the initial AI scan is manually reviewed by trained human moderators. These moderators identify and escalate any content featuring individuals who are not verified or lack a signed release form.
* **Reactive Measures:** If unverified content is posted, OnlyFans flags it and typically gives the creator 48 hours to submit the proper documentation. Failure to comply results in content removal or account suspension.

**Content Flagging and Moderation Software for Your Platform**

For your own platform, you will need a robust content moderation system that likely combines AI-powered tools and a workflow for human review.

Here is software available for content flagging, moderation, and managing digital forms:

| **Category** | **Software Name** | **Description** | **Key Features for Your Use Case** |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| **Content Moderation Platforms** | **Sightengine** | A platform focused on AI-powered image and video analysis and content moderation. | Detects adult, violent, or graphic content, and can perform image forensics to detect tampering of documents/IDs. |
|  | **Amazon Rekognition**(AWS) | A deep learning-based image and video analysis service. | Can detect inappropriate content, recognize faces, and verify identities (useful for ID checks). |
|  | **Azure AI Content Safety**(Microsoft) | AI-powered content moderation service that detects harmful text and images. | Classifier models detect various harm categories and can be integrated into custom platforms. |
|  | **Perspective API**(Google) | Uses machine learning models to identify toxic or harmful language in text. | Useful for moderating comments or user input fields. |
| **Digital Release Forms** | **DocuSign** | A widely used e-signature and digital document management solution. | Facilitates secure, legally binding electronic signatures for model release forms and ID collection. |
|  | **Adobe Acrobat Sign** | Provides electronic signature and form management, integrated with other Adobe services. | Allows for creation, sending, and tracking of model release forms with e-signatures. |
|  | **PandaDoc / Zoho Sign** | Other alternatives for creating, sharing, and e-signing business documents and contracts. | User-friendly interfaces for collecting necessary legal consents. |

1. **Implement a Forms Workflow:** Use a service like DocuSign or Adobe Sign to manage the collection of legally compliant model release forms and ID verification from collaborators.
2. **Create a Verification System:** Tie the submitted forms and ID verification to user accounts in your database, allowing creators to "tag" verified users to bypass moderation flags for approved content.
